description: Machine-readable definition of the dcc-mcp adapter contract: the rules that apply to Python packages built on dcc-mcp-core. Loaded with scripts/check_repo_contract.py --contract contract/adapter_contract.json, so it reuses the gates, profiles, annotations, and nightly sweep of the repository contract without redefining any of them. A criterion is never written down twice.

profiles.baseline: Rules that every adapter repository is expected to satisfy today. Adapters start here and ratchet up.
profiles.strict: All rules including the ones still being rolled out by the PIP-4104 sub-issues. Opt in per repository once it is clean.

rules.name: adapter-python-package
rules.title: The repository is a Python package that declares dcc-mcp-core
rules.summary: The adapter contract only applies to Python packages that declare a dependency on one of adapter_marker_dependencies. A registered repository that does not is reported at notice severity so the manifest stays honest; this rule scopes the contract, it constrains no code.
